title: LPC/RC to Autocorrelation
text: Convert linear prediction coefficients or reflection coefficients to autocorrelation coefficients, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {If first input value is not 1} sets Action to take if first input value is not; {Type of conversion} and {Specify P} sets the method of specifying prediction error power P Assume P. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type of conversion
params.values: Type of conversion LPC to autocorrelation (default) | RC to autocorrelation

params.name: Specify P
params.values: Method of specifying prediction error power P Assume P = 1 (default) | Via input port

params.name: If first input value is not 1
params.values: Action to take if first input value is not 1 Replace it with 1 (default) | Normalize | Normalize and warn | Error
